bibl.title: Climate Change in the Breadbasket of the Roman Empire - Explaining the Decline of the Fayum Villages in the Third Century CE.
bibl.note: 1. Climate change, the Nile, and Egyptian history. - 2. The Nilotic environment in the Graeco-Roman Fayum. - 3. The decline of the Fayum in the third century CE: 3.1 The breakdown of the irrigation system; - 3.2. Political upheaval, socio-economic changes, and demographic crisis. - 4. Climate change at the source areas of the Nile during the third century CE: 4.1. Historical records for Nile floods during the Graeco-Roman period; - 4.2. Historical and palaeoclimatological reconstructions of third-century CE Nile floods. - 5. Conclusions.
